tagline: STIHL, Honda, and everything to keep it running
heroSubheading: Sales, servicing, and parts for every machine you rely on
aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Wairoa, your local dealer for outdoor power equipment. We stock STIHL, Honda Power Equipment, Briggs & Stratton, Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, and Hansa Chippers. Whether you need a new machine or parts for the one you've got, we've got it covered.

We're authorised service and repair agents for every brand we stock. Beyond sales, we handle servicing and repairs. We also stock Castrol lubricants for farm and forestry equipment, so you can keep your gear running smoothly.

Craig and the team know Wairoa, and we know what locals need. Come in and talk through what you're after. We're open Monday to Friday, 7:45am to 5:30pm, and we're ready to help.
